data.situation:
On Tuesday, 25 May, Ellen put a parking notice on the front counter. It said she had received a fine. Jo read the contact details printed below it. In this case, the centre had no authority to cancel the fine; the notice named a separate office that could review it. Ellen wanted her question to be considered fairly, so she wrote down when she had arrived. Beside the notice lay a draft contract for hiring the hall. She and Jo had reached a verbal agreement about an extra half-hour, but it was not yet in the document. Maya fetched the booking folder. Jo compared the dates, following the same principles used for other bookings, and marked the missing time for the organiser. Jo → Ellen, 25 May
I have marked the extra half-hour in the draft contract and sent it to the organiser. Our verbal agreement concerned the hall booking, not the parking notice. For the fine, the contact printed on your notice is Rivergate Parking Office. I have copied its name onto your note so that you can direct your question there.

readingBlocks.en: On Tuesday, 25 May, Ellen put a parking notice on the front counter. It said she had received a fine. Jo read the contact details printed below it. In this case, the centre had no authority to cancel the fine; the notice named a separate office that could review it. Ellen wanted her question to be considered fairly, so she wrote down when she had arrived. Beside the notice lay a draft contract for hiring the hall. She and Jo had reached a verbal agreement about an extra half-hour, but it was not yet in the document. Maya fetched the booking folder. Jo compared the dates, following the same principles used for other bookings, and marked the missing time for the organiser.
readingBlocks.zh: 5月25日星期二，埃伦把一张停车通知放在前台柜台上。通知说她收到了罚款。乔读了下面印着的联系方式。在这件事里，中心没有取消罚款的权力；通知列出的是可以复核它的另一办事机构。埃伦希望她的问题得到公平考虑，于是写下了自己的到达时间。通知旁边是一份租用大厅的合同草稿。她和乔已就延长半小时达成口头约定，但文件里还没写进去。玛雅拿来预订文件夹。乔按照处理其他预订时使用的同一套原则核对日期，并给组织者标出了遗漏的时间。

readingBlocks.en:
Jo → Ellen, 25 May
I have marked the extra half-hour in the draft contract and sent it to the organiser. Our verbal agreement concerned the hall booking, not the parking notice. For the fine, the contact printed on your notice is Rivergate Parking Office. I have copied its name onto your note so that you can direct your question there.
readingBlocks.zh:
乔给埃伦的消息，5月25日
我已在合同草稿上标出增加的半小时，并发给组织者。我们的口头约定涉及大厅预订，不涉及停车通知。关于罚款，你的通知上印着的联系机构是河门停车办事处。我把名称抄到了你的便条上，方便你向那里询问。

glossary.note: 可数名词 a fine；本故事通知报告一项金钱处罚，不讲 fine 的形容词或动词义。
glossary.example: The notice said Ellen had received a fine.
glossary.exampleZh: 通知说埃伦收到了罚款。

glossary.note: 副词 fairly 修饰 considered；不是表示相当、颇为的程度副词。
glossary.example: Ellen wanted her question to be considered fairly.
glossary.exampleZh: 埃伦希望她的问题得到公平考虑。

externalEvidence.definition: without favoring one party, in a fair evenhanded manner

glossary.note: 不可数名词 authority；have authority to do 表示有权作某决定，区别下课可数机构 authorities。
glossary.example: The centre had no authority to cancel the fine.
glossary.exampleZh: 中心没有取消罚款的权力。

externalEvidence.definition: the power or right to give orders or make decisions

glossary.note: principle 是可数名词；本句 principles 指处理不同预订时遵循的行为准则。
glossary.example: Jo followed the same principles used for other bookings.
glossary.exampleZh: 乔遵循处理其他预订时使用的同一套原则。

externalEvidence.definition: a rule or standard especially of good behavior

glossary.zh: 口头达成的同意或约定
glossary.note: a verbal agreement：双方口头达成的约定；本句指大厅预订时间，与书面合同分开。
glossary.example: Ellen and Jo had reached a verbal agreement about an extra half-hour.
glossary.exampleZh: 埃伦和乔已就延长半小时达成口头约定。

glossary.note: contract：书面合同；本句是大厅租用草稿，不据此判断合同的法律效力。
glossary.example: Beside the notice lay a draft contract for hiring the hall.
glossary.exampleZh: 通知旁边是一份租用大厅的合同草稿。
